**Finding: deviation (LOL-CAP)** — Section 21.1.

Section 21 is well-built in every respect but one: the cap is mutual, indirect/consequential damages are mutually excluded (21.2), and the Excluded Claims definition (21.3) already carves out confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, and confirms Customer's payment obligation is not "damages."

The defect is quantum. The cap runs to "Fees," and §1.5 defines Fees as the Implementation Fee, which §1.8 fixes as a one-time USD 12,000 charge under the first Order Form — and 21.1 independently narrows the basis to "the first Order Form." The result is an effective ~USD 12,000 cap on both parties irrespective of actual subscription spend, well below the 12-months'-fees fallback and below the 6-month walk-away line.

Redline (validated, ok:true): rebase 21.1 to "the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000," leaving the rest of Section 21 untouched.
